title: Playing telephone with generative models: “verification disability,” “compelled reliance,” and accessibility in data visualization

bias_targets.methodology: Playing an iterative 'telephone' game with generative vision-language models (ChatGPT and Claude) by alternating between generating text descriptions of a data visualization and recreating the visualization from the generated text. The study evaluates how model failures—such as information loss, fabrication, and intentional under-description when prompted specifically for blind users—create biased and harmful accessibility artifacts for people with visual impairments.
